gloss: inexperienced person; beginner; person with no prior experience

definitions.gloss: inexperienced person; person with no prior experience
definitions.explanation: someone who has not done a particular job, activity, or task before

examples.japanese: {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for job postings that welcome inexperienced applicants.

examples.japanese: {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can someone with no experience apply?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}している→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{働|はたら}ける→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: This company provides thorough training programs even for those with no experience, so you can work with peace of mind.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet; un-) + ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (experience) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Very commonly seen in job listings and recruitment contexts. The phrase {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ (inexperienced applicants welcome) is a standard line in Japanese job ads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧: inexperienced applicants welcome
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}OK: no experience required (informal listing)
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}{可|か}: inexperienced persons accepted
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧: it's fine even for beginners

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧: beginner — focuses on skill level rather than work history; used for hobbies and learning too
- ⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧: experienced person — the antonym
- ⟦{素人|しろうと}→素人：04270_shirouto⟧: amateur; layperson — more casual and can carry a slightly dismissive nuance
